caption: 01 · IDENTITY — Is this the same object?. Record stable identifier, components, marks, labels, measurements, materials, images, condition, alterations, and comparison basis; note uncertainty and separated parts.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping is this the same object? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · CHAIN — Can each custody event be evidenced?. Attach acquisition, gift, inheritance, loan, sale, deposit, return, location, responsible party, document, date, and restriction without inventing missing links.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can each custody event be evidenced? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · INTERVENE — What changed the object or record?. Log repair, conservation, cleaning, alteration, reframing, digitization, renaming, reattribution, exhibition, reproduction, and metadata correction.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what changed the object or record? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · CLAIM — How confident is the story?. Label verified fact, physical observation, attributed conclusion, participant account, inference, disputed statement, and unresolved gap; retain earlier versions and correction history.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping how confident is the story? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
